entities.name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
observations: In a retrospective Child-Pugh A hepatectomy cohort, transfusion was associated with worse recurrence-free survival after weighting (HR 1.45, 95% CI 1.0–2.1; P=0.038; PMID:25446481).

entities.name: Perioperative blood transfusion
observations: Observational studies assess perioperative allogeneic transfusion, but adjusted recurrence findings are mixed.

entities.name: PMID:25446481
observations: In 479 Child-Pugh A patients undergoing curative hepatectomy, weighted transfusion exposure was associated with worse recurrence-free survival (HR 1.45, 95% CI 1.0–2.1; P=0.038); adjusted overall-survival difference was not significant.

entities.name: PMID:37854678
observations: Meta-analysis of propensity-matched studies found perioperative allogeneic transfusion associated with worse RFS (HR 1.29, 95% CI 1.07–1.56); BCLC-A subgroup is not equivalent to Child-Pugh A.

entities.name: Transfusion and HCC recurrence
observations: Direct Child-Pugh A cohort supports an association with recurrence after hepatectomy, but adjusted cohorts are mixed and all evidence is observational; causation is unproven.
